description: This PHP class 'ProjectReportData' generates report data for project activities within the OrangeHRM system's time tracking plugin. It retrieves project activities, formats durations, constructs URLs with report filters, and provides metadata including total durations and project details.

classes.name: ProjectReportData
classes.description: Implements report data logic for project activity reports, including data retrieval, formatting, and metadata generation.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Generates an array of formatted project activity report data, including activity details and URLs for further report views.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Provides metadata about the project report, such as total duration, activity count, and normalized project information.
